{{Flavor|"Be sure to stop by in person once in a while. Until then, I don't know... Maybe see you around?"}} | rarity = rare | bound = account | collection = Gobblers and Exchanges Collector | type = gizmo | id = 101771 | requires = Soto }} A portable version of [[Gharr Leadclaw|Gharr Leadclaw's]] inventory. == Acquisition == === Sold by === {{Sold by}} Crafting the [[Purified Rift Essence]] requires: * Any [[crafting discipline]] (aside from [[Handiworker]]) of level 400. * Purchasing [[Recipe: Amalgamated Rift Essence]] and [[Recipe: Purified Rift Essence]] for {{silver|50}} each. * Alternatively, certain NPCs (such as [[Lyhr]]) provide crafting services that can be bought with a fee of 10 {{item icon|Glob of Ectoplasm}} for each step. Its materials consist of: * 1 {{item icon|Amalgamated Rift Essence}}, which consists of: ** 250 {{item icon|Fine Rift Essence}} ** 100 {{item icon|Masterwork Rift Essence}} ** 50 {{item icon|Rare Rift Essence}} ** 50 {{item icon|Glob of Ectoplasm}} * 1 {{item icon|Mystic Clover}} == Text == The device shimmers, and you can hear [[Gharr Leadclaw|Gharr]] speaking. "Salutations, [[Wayfinder]]. Where would you like to exchange from?" :{{dialogue icon|sell}} ''[[Heart of Maguuma]], please.'' :{{dialogue icon|sell}} ''[[Crystal Desert]], please.'' :{{dialogue icon|sell}} ''[[Cantha]], please.'' :{{dialogue icon|sell}} ''[[Horn of Maguuma]], please.'' :{{dialogue icon|sell}} ''[[Janthir]], please.'' :{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Anywhere else?'' ::Wouldn't you like to know? That info is an obscure secret. ::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''Not even a little hint?'' :{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Just saying hello.'' == Items offered == Due to the substantial number of offers possibly
